text:
sam: Heads-up — we're seeing sustained egress saturation from tenant 'corp-x' in eu-west-1, looks like it's chewing rack headroom (r-a-12). Thinking of soft-pinning them to a quiet-affinity slice for 2h to stop spillover. Anyone object?
priya: Can you paste the numbers? SLA impact or just noise?
sam: Link to dashboard: https://dash.internal/eu-west1/r-a-12 — 5m egress util at 88%, tail spikes to 96% on 95th. Latency SLOs for other tenants drifting ~30ms. No 5xx so far.
jess: Soft-pin + shaping is fine. Two concerns: 1) if we move them, KV cache warmup could spike CPU on the target slice, 2) need cost attribution for any dedicated headroom used.
sam: Agree. Proposal: apply allocation tag + affinity TTL to move new allocs only (no forced live-migrate). That should avoid cold-cache storm. Then enable egress policer on origin rack.
leo: Sample patch I ran in staging (psudo):
```
PATCH /api/v1/allocations?filter=tenant=corp-x
{
  "affinity": "quiet-affinity",
  "affinity_ttl": "2h",
  "egress_policer": "soft-70pct"
}
```
This avoids disrupting existing long-lived allocs.
infra-bot: ALERT: [r-a-12] egress_util=92% (5m avg) — triggered egress-headroom alert at 2026-10-03T09:12:18Z :warning:
priya: If we do soft-pin, can we also decrement the rack-level admission for best-effort jobs to free I/O? Need to surface chargeback to billing so account team doesn't get surprised.
sam: Yep — will add a quick ledger tag so billing picks up temporary headroom charge. Also will lower BE queue weight: `be.weight=0.2` for the rack.
jess: Also request ops-runbook note: when removing soft-pin after TTL, validate 95th stays <80% for 10m before fully unpinning.
leo: On it. I'll kick the patch now in eu-west staging, then prod if green in 10m.
priya: Greenlight from me once the billing tag is attached.
sam: thanks — doing the patch. Will post results in 10m. :thumbsup:
jess: :thumbsup: good call. Keep an eye on KV cache miss rate.
